instruction.text: Select the man to find out what he thinks caused the plague.

atoms.b: This was a common belief for people in 1665. They called these ((++bad good)) smells miasmas.
We know now that ((++miasmas laughing)) didn’t actually cause the plague.

instruction.text: Now select the woman to find out what she thinks caused the plague.

atoms.sound: it is the cats and dogs that cause the plague.

feedback.finish: Many people believed cats and dogs were the cause of the Great Plague, but cats actually helped to stop the plague from spreading! They caught the rats that carried the disease.

instruction.text: Let’s listen in more to their conversation about the causes of the plague. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: I’ve heard that some people think the plague is a ((++punishment gift)) from God.
Yes, I have heard that. Many also say it is ((++caused squashed)) by having too much blood in the body.
That is interesting. Maybe someone is poisoning our wells so the ((++water sun_cream)) makes us ill.
Someone also told me yesterday that they believe the location of the planets caused the ((++plague fire)).

feedback.finish: None of these ideas about what caused the plague were actually correct, but people believed them because there was a lack of knowledge about medicine and disease.
